name: Barrel of Barleybrew Scalder
summary: At Kharanos, Marleth Barleybrew sends a cask of Scalder toward the Thunderbrew Distillery. He means to prove his brewing can rival the Thunderbrews, his chief competitors.

sections.title: A Bitter Feud in Dun Morogh
sections.body: The Thunderbrews and Barleybrews contend fiercely over brewing in Dun Morogh. The Thunderbrews are renowned for their busy distillery in Kharanos. Marleth Barleybrew will not live in their shadow. So he brews fiery Scalder to show his recipes can rival theirs. He hopes those who taste it will see the Thunderbrews do not own the art of fine dwarven drink.

sections.title: Subterfuge in the Cellar
sections.body: The barrel is bound for the cellars beneath the Thunderbrew Distillery. There it will take the place of a cask of Thunder Ale, a local favorite. Wounded pride has given rise to a prank, not poison or ruin. The next batch served upstairs will secretly be Barleybrew's potent Scalder.

faq.q: What is inside the Barrel of Barleybrew Scalder?
faq.answer: The barrel holds Marleth Barleybrew's signature Scalder, a potent dwarven brew made to rival the Thunderbrew family's famed recipes.

faq.q: Why does Marleth want this barrel swapped?
faq.answer: Marleth admits the Thunderbrews make good drinks, but he wants them to learn humility. He hopes cellar patrons will taste his brew without knowing it and find Barleybrew craftsmanship just as good, if not better.

aliases: where do i put the barrel
faq.answer: The barrel goes into the cellar beneath the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. It takes the place on the racks of a cask of Thunder Ale due to be tapped.

faq.q: Is the brew meant to harm anyone?
faq.answer: No. The brew is a strong dwarven ale meant to rival the Thunderbrews'. The families' rivalry is fierce, but it comes from professional pride, not malice.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know ale crafting as both an art and a bloodsport. Dun Morogh's recipe rivalries reach all the way into the cellar.
As a rogue, you can distract a cellar guard and slip heavy contraband into a guarded stash. Here, you get a taste of dwarven subterfuge with little at stake.
